title: Reinos de la Frontera — RTS medieval isométrico
objective: Desarrollar el RTS medieval isométrico 'Reinos de la Frontera' desde cero, cumpliendo los entregables de los spikes E0‑E6, con enfoque en render, simulación determinista, economía, combate, IA, UI y entrega final.

steps.task: Scaffold inicial (Fase 0) - repositorio, project.godot, main.tscn, Godot 4.7.2 verificado
steps.exit_criteria: Commit inicial creado, archivos project.godot y main.tscn presentes, Godot 4.7.2 ejecutado sin errores.
evidence: repo projects/reinos-de-la-frontera; commits 437a6a7, 3c53d54, a247753; SCAFFOLD_OK; capture docs/captures/fase0.png 1600x900
repo projects/reinos-de-la-frontera; HEAD a3ddeee; SCAFFOLD_OK+HEADLESS_OK; capture 1600x900; B functional PASS, commit message fixed to English

steps.exit_criteria: Run 'godot --headless --script res://tests/e0_day1_test.gd' (exit 0) and assert: Camera3D.projection == PROJECTION_ORTHOGONAL, size == 14, near == 0.1, far == 200, rotation_degrees == Vector3(-30,45,0), position != Vector3.ZERO; then render docs/captures/e0-day1.png with a real renderer via 'godot --path . --write-movie ... --quit-after 3' (NOT --headless) and verify the image shows a character at 1.8 m against a 1 m tile.

steps.task: E0 Día 2 - 200 unidades animadas, medición de performance
steps.exit_criteria: Render with the real Metal renderer, NOT --headless: 'godot --path . --fullscreen --resolution 3440x1440 spike/e0_day2_perf.tscn'. 200 animated units, Engine.max_fps=0, vsync off, 10 s warm-up and 60 s sample. Write docs/captures/e0-day2_metrics.csv with p50/p95/p99, draw calls and unit count. Pass if p95 <= 16.7 ms, p99 <= 16.7 ms and <= 0.1% of frames > 33 ms. macOS clamps a windowed 3440x1440 to 1288 height, so the reference run is fullscreen. Also run once with vsync on and Engine.max_fps=60 to confirm pacing.
evidence: fullscreen 3440x1440; 5289 frames; p50 11.6ms p95 13.07ms p99 13.76ms max 26.0ms; over33 0; 537 draw calls; DAY2_OK; B PASS
